summary: Lozito Law, LLC is a small New Jersey real estate law firm formed in 2013 by Danielle M. Lozito, Esq., now with a second attorney (Alyssa N. Seiden, Esq.), handling residential and commercial real estate transactions and simple estate planning from an office at 480 Georges Road, North Brunswick. The entire web presence is a two-page WordPress/Divi brochure site: no contact form, no online booking, no click-to-call link, no published hours and no dedicated service or contact page. Clients reach the firm only by two phone lines, a fax number or a Gmail address, and the site's titles still name Milltown while the address block says North Brunswick.

facts.fact: Firm was formed in 2013 by Danielle M. Lozito, Esq. (New York Law School 2002, admitted in NJ and NY); she describes the practice as transactional real estate, both commercial and residential
The About page profiles two attorneys: Danielle M. Lozito, Esq. and Alyssa N. Seiden, Esq. (Hofstra University School of Law 2001), both admitted in NJ and NY
Practice areas listed on the site: commercial real estate transactions, residential real estate transactions, simple estate planning
Sitewide address is 480 Georges Rd, North Brunswick, NJ 08902, described as 'conveniently located in Middlesex County next to Rutgers University'
Published contact details are p. 848-202-1650, p. 848-202-1651, f. 848-202-1653 and email lozitolaw@gmail.com
The firm says it represents clients from 'all over the State, Country and throughout the world' and can 'orchestrate signings from afar using Remote Online Notarization'
Page title and Yoast site name still read 'Milltown, NJ' while the address block on the same page reads North Brunswick
The XML sitemap contains exactly two pages (home and about); home last modified 2025-04-16, about last modified 2023-05-18

Google Business Profile shows 4.4 stars, category 'Real estate attorney', address 480 Georges Rd, phone (848) 202-1650, status 'Closed - Opens 9 AM Mon' and wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking lot and restroom; the review count is not shown in the limited view

Third-party review aggregator Birdeye lists 4.5 stars from 83 reviews, category Real Estate Law, Milltown NJ, with hours Mon-Fri 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., closed weekends; the profile is flagged as not claimed by the business
The firm is a listed member of the Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce with the 480 Georges Road address and (848) 202-1650 phone
Lozito Law, LLC appears on the Milltown 4th of July committee's public sponsor list, linked to lozitolaw.com

operations_signals: Only intake channels are two printed phone numbers, a fax number and a mailto: link to lozitolaw@gmail.com; no web form, chat or scheduler exists anywhere on the site (rendered DOM on the homepage has zero forms, zero inputs, zero iframes and zero tel: links) (https://lozitolaw.com/)

No business hours are published on the firm's own site; the only hours found are third-party - Mon-Fri 9-5, closed weekends, from an unclaimed aggregator listing (https://reviews.birdeye.com/lozito-law-llc-155668563161464)

Top navigation is Home, About, Legal and Contact, where 'Legal' and 'Contact' are anchor links pointing into the About page; the sitemap confirms no standalone contact, services or careers page exists (https://lozitolaw.com/page-sitemap.xml)

Inquiry handling therefore depends on someone answering the phone or monitoring a consumer Gmail mailbox during weekday business hours; nothing on the site captures an after-hours lead (https://lozitolaw.com/about-lozito-law/)

The firm markets remote capability for closings - signings can be orchestrated remotely via Remote Online Notarization, so at least part of the closing workflow is already digital (https://lozitolaw.com/)

The site's NinjaFirewall returned '403 Forbidden' to repeated automated requests during this review, on /contact/ and later on /about-lozito-law/, so automated clients and agents can be shut out even while human visitors are served (https://lozitolaw.com/contact/)
hiring_signals: No current job postings found for Lozito Law on Indeed, LinkedIn or Glassdoor after targeted searches; the only near-matches were unrelated firms with similar names (https://www.indeed.com/q-legal-assistant-l-milltown%2C-nj-jobs.html)
No careers page exists - the sitemap lists only the home and about pages, so hiring would run through informal channels rather than the website (https://lozitolaw.com/page-sitemap.xml)

Review text references helpful office staff handling client contact, implying at least one non-attorney support person, but no role, name or headcount is published (https://reviews.birdeye.com/lozito-law-llc-155668563161464)
review_themes: Recurring praise for responsiveness, professionalism and keeping clients informed 'every step of the way' during closings (https://reviews.birdeye.com/lozito-law-llc-155668563161464)

Realtor reviewers describe using the firm repeatedly across many closings and cite attention to detail as the reason they recommend it to clients (https://reviews.birdeye.com/lozito-law-llc-155668563161464)

At least one reviewer reports dissatisfaction with the firm and separately with a title company the firm recommended - a single account, not a pattern I could verify (https://reviews.birdeye.com/lozito-law-llc-155668563161464)

Ratings differ by source: Google shows 4.4 with the review count hidden, while the aggregator shows 4.5 from 83 reviews, so volume and exact score are not independently confirmed (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Lozito+Law+LLC+480+Georges+Rd+North+Brunswick+NJ)
tech_footprint: WordPress on the Divi 4.27.4 theme with Yoast SEO 25.8, MonsterInsights Google Analytics 4 (G-3SLHJB2DSK), WP Fastest Cache minification and NinjaFirewall (https://lozitolaw.com/)
No booking widget, chat widget, CRM embed, payment or client portal anywhere; script inventory is limited to jQuery, Divi assets and the Google Analytics tag (https://lozitolaw.com/)

Contact email is a free Gmail address rather than a domain mailbox, and the only structured data is a Yoast Organization/WebSite graph carrying name, logo and a LinkedIn sameAs - no address, phone, hours or legal-service schema (https://lozitolaw.com/about-lozito-law/)
No blog, no FAQ, no case results, no downloadable checklist or document list and no pricing content; the sitemap has two URLs total (https://lozitolaw.com/page-sitemap.xml)

Site is photo-led with large kitchen and interior hero images and no H1 or H2 headings on the homepage; at 390 px the hero logo renders as a full-width 390x390 block that fills the opening screen before any text appears (https://lozitolaw.com/)

Google Business Profile is live and links to the website with phone and address, while the aggregator profile is unclaimed, leaving duplicate listing data unmanaged (https://reviews.birdeye.com/lozito-law-llc-155668563161464)
growth_signals: Second attorney added to the practice - Alyssa N. Seiden, Esq. is profiled alongside the founder, indicating capacity beyond a solo practice (https://lozitolaw.com/about-lozito-law/)

Community and referral-network marketing: listed member of the Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce and a sponsor of the Milltown 4th of July (https://www.mcrcc.org/business-directory/lozito-law/)

Attorney appeared as a guest on a mortgage-industry podcast episode titled 'Real Estate Law 101 with Danielle Lozito', positioning the firm with lender and realtor referral sources (https://www.buzzsprout.com/2399236/episodes/16142614-real-estate-law-101-with-danielle-lozito)

Site was last touched in April 2025 (home page lastmod) while the About page has not changed since May 2023, suggesting low ongoing marketing investment rather than active expansion (https://lozitolaw.com/page-sitemap.xml)
physical_signals: Single office at 480 Georges Road, North Brunswick, NJ 08902, in Middlesex County near Rutgers University; no branch or satellite office is listed (https://lozitolaw.com/)

About page photo gallery shows interior office space with a large meeting table, gold pendant lighting and paneled/kitchen-style millwork; no square footage, seat count or staff count is stated (https://lozitolaw.com/about-lozito-law/)
Google lists the location as wheelchair accessible with an accessible entrance, parking lot and restroom (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Lozito+Law+LLC+480+Georges+Rd+North+Brunswick+NJ)
Closings can be handled remotely via Remote Online Notarization, reducing dependence on physical signing appointments at the office (https://lozitolaw.com/)
No public-records datasets apply here (no fleet, food service or licensed facility); I found no OSHA or building-permit records specific to the firm
decision_maker: Danielle M. Lozito, Esq. - named attorney and founder of Lozito Law, LLC (the site does not state a title such as managing partner), https://lozitolaw.com/about-lozito-law/

inferences.inference: Every new matter starts with a manual phone call or a Gmail message, so after-hours and mid-closing inquiries are likely lost or answered late
inferences.reasoning: The only contact paths are two phone numbers and a mailto link; there is no form, chatbot or scheduler, and the only hours available (third-party) are 9-5 weekdays. Two attorneys closing active deals cannot reliably answer the phone on signing days.

inferences.inference: A large share of staff time goes to repetitive closing coordination - document collection, status updates to buyers/sellers/agents, and scheduling signings
inferences.reasoning: The practice is described as almost entirely transactional residential and commercial real estate, where each file requires the same checklist, party notifications and appointment-setting. Reviews repeatedly praise 'keeping in contact every step of the way', which implies substantial manual update work.

inferences.inference: Local search visibility is diluted by the Milltown/North Brunswick mismatch and a stale two-page site
inferences.reasoning: Titles and site name still say Milltown while the office is in North Brunswick; the About page has not changed since May 2023; there are no service or location pages, and structured data omits address, phone and hours.

inferences.inference: The firm most likely runs on realtor, lender and title-company referrals rather than inbound web leads
inferences.reasoning: Reviews come from agents describing repeat closings, the firm sponsors a local civic event, belongs to a chamber of commerce, and the attorney appeared on a mortgage-industry podcast - all referral channels. The website has no lead capture, consistent with not needing web leads.

inferences.inference: Third-party data about the firm will keep drifting from the source of truth
inferences.reasoning: Directories still carry the old Milltown address, the Birdeye profile is unclaimed, and the firewall blocks some automated requests, so listings and crawlers get stale or partial information.

data_gaps: Google review count and review text were behind Google Maps' 'limited view' and a sign-in wall; a Google web search for reviews returned a CAPTCHA, so only the 4.4 rating, category and open/closed status are verified

The site's NinjaFirewall intermittently served 403 Forbidden pages to the research browser (on /contact/ and, after several requests, on /about-lozito-law/), so I could not capture the About page at 390 px or confirm what a visitor sees at /contact/; an HTTP fetch of /contact/ earlier returned homepage content
Lawyer.com, Super Lawyers and Avvo pages returned 403 or blocked access, so the negative review snippets returned by search are unverified and excluded from the themes list
No job postings, employee counts, revenue figures or square footage are published anywhere I could reach; absence of postings is not evidence the firm is not hiring
No public records (FMCSA, OSHA, health inspections, permits) apply to or were found for a two-attorney law office
No confirmed Facebook page; a Nextdoor listing exists per search results but was not opened
